title: Fetch runtime handler
responsibility: Wraps a unit runtime in the common HTTP JSON request and response protocol.

inputs.name: runtimeFetch.runtime
inputs.description: Runtime supplied to runtimeReply for each Request handled by the returned function. runtimeFetch does not start a server or close this runtime.

outputs.name: runtimeFetch
outputs.description: Returns an async Request handler that passes the request method and a callback reading request.text() to runtimeReply, then creates a Response from JSON.stringify(reply.value) using reply.status and the content-type application/json and cache-control no-store headers. Creating the handler does not start a server or close the runtime.

errors.name: Propagated error
errors.description: The returned handler rejects if awaiting runtimeReply, reading request.text(), serializing reply.value, or constructing Response fails; runtimeFetch does not catch or translate these failures.
